    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_common_stable_weight_of_same_locus (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (h : IsEFinite R) {X Y : FGModuleCat R} (hX : IsBrick X) (hY : IsBrick Y) (hl : ∀ (g : ProjectiveClass R), ((projectiveClassWeight k) g).IsSemistable X ↔ ((projectiveClassWeight k) g).IsSemistable Y) :

    Adding the two individual stability weights gives a common stability weight whenever the integral semistability loci of two bricks coincide.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.iso_of_same_locus_of_proportional (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (h : IsEFinite R) {X Y : FGModuleCat R} (hX : IsBrick X) (hY : IsBrick Y) (hl : ∀ (g : ProjectiveClass R), ((projectiveClassWeight k) g).IsSemistable X ↔ ((projectiveClassWeight k) g).IsSemistable Y) {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (he : a • GrothendieckGroup.of X = b • GrothendieckGroup.of Y) :
    Nonempty (X ≅ Y)

    Proportional ambient classes and the same integral semistability locus determine a brick up to isomorphism in an E-finite algebra.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_stable_perturbation (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {Y : FGModuleCat R} {θ : Weight (FGModuleCat R)} (hy : θ.IsStable Y) (w : Weight (FGModuleCat R)) (hw : w.eval Y = 0) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ), (N • θ + w).IsStable Y

    A sufficiently large multiple of a stability weight absorbs any integral perturbation vanishing on the module class.
